headline: Gold steady today at ₹14,461 per gram (24K); silver flat near ₹2,04,900 per kg
summary: Today's move is tiny: 24K gold rose ₹1 per gram (0.01%) and 22K gold also rose ₹1, while silver eased ₹100 per kg (0.05%). Over the last 7 days gold is up about 3.56% (₹497 per gram for 24K), but silver is up 2.45% over the same week, and over the 16 days in our history gold is up 1.3% while silver is down 6.86%. Likely drivers include the US dollar, the rupee (about ₹94 to the dollar) and international gold and silver prices, though the spot data shows no move since today's rate was set.
outlook: With prices flat today, there is no urgency either way; if you are buying jewellery, compare making charges and GST across shops, since those matter more than a one-day change.
